title: Coincidence-Maximizing Customer Clustering Using Smart Meter Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.28178v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electricity distribution planning depends on peak-demand coincidence within customer groups, yet similarity-based clustering of smart-meter data does not optimize it directly. We formulate customer grouping to maximize the average of group coincidence factors, weighted by each group's daily share of summed individual peak demand. We prove that jointly optimizing memberships and group peak times is strongly NP-hard even for two groups. We therefore develop a fixed-peak refinement procedure applicable to any feasible partition. It alternates between identifying group peak times and exactly reassigning customers under minimum group-size constraints. Each polynomial-time reassignment maximizes a lower bound tight at the current partition, so accepted updates strictly improve weighted coincidence. translated_title: 基于智能电表数据的峰值同时率最大化客户聚类
translated_abstract: 配电网规划依赖于客户群体内的峰值需求同时率，然而基于相似性的智能电表数据聚类并不能直接对其进行优化。我们将客户分组问题形式化为最大化各组同时系数的加权平均值，其中权重为每组个体峰值需求之和在每日总峰值需求中所占的份额。我们证明，即使只有两个组，联合优化客户归属与组峰值时刻的问题也是强NP难的。因此，我们开发了一种适用于任何可行划分的固定峰值精化程序。该程序交替进行两个步骤：识别各组峰值时刻，以及在最小组规模约束下对客户进行精确重新分配。每次多项式时间的重新分配都在最大化一个在当前划分处取到紧值的下界，因此被接受的更新能够严格改进加权同时率。我们通过对个体峰值时刻分布进行聚类来初始化精化过程，并在四个公开的智能电表数据集（27,654个用户……
tldr: 该论文证明即使只有两个组，最大化加权峰值同时率的客户分组问题也是强NP难的，并提出了一种交替确定组峰值时刻与精确重新分配客户的多项式时间固定峰值精化算法，可严格改进加权同时率，并在四个公开智能电表数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that customer clustering to maximize weighted peak-demand coincidence is strongly NP-hard even with two groups, and develops a polynomial-time fixed-peak refinement procedure that alternately identifies group peak times and exactly reassigns customers to strictly improve weighted coincidence, validated on four public smart-meter datasets.
